summary: Targeted frontend regression check for Hero headline Devanagari clipping bug fix. Verified H1 (data-testid=hero-headline) and subtitle (hero-tagline) render all glyphs without clipping on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Mask spans now provide sufficient vertical padding (paddingBottom 30.4px, paddingTop 6.08px with matching negative margins) so matras/conjuncts in भूमिपूजन, गृहप्रवेश, सफ़र, आपका, साथ, हमारा are fully visible. Entrance slide-up animation plays cleanly per line (0.9s stagger). Smoke-tested hero CTAs: 'Try the Cost Calculator' scrolls to #calculator on both desktop (scrollY>100) and mobile (scrollY=8367). No console errors observed. Backend testing skipped per request.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx uses `-mb-[0.4em] -mt-[0.08em]` negative margins to cancel the extra padding added for Devanagari matras. This works but means every line's visual box collapses to original line-height — fine for current layout, but worth noting that if the designer ever shrinks line-height further the mask bottom could re-clip. Measured: mask height 131.19px vs inner 112px (~19px headroom) at mobile — adequate.
LINES array (भूमिपूजन से गृहप्रवेश तक,/सफ़र आपका./साथ हमारा.) is a hardcoded content literal in Hero.jsx — fine for current MVP but could move to a content config if copy iterates.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero clipping bug fix is verified. Hero.jsx mask spans use pb-[0.4em]/-mb-[0.4em] and pt-[0.08em]/-mt-[0.08em] with leading-[1.4] for the H1. Full-site regression (backend 14/14, frontend 100%) was done in iteration_1 — not re-run.
rca_of_the_issue: Original clipping: the overflow-hidden mask span used for the per-line slide-up reveal animation had pb-[0.1em]/-mb-[0.1em], tuned for Latin glyphs. Devanagari matras (ू, ृ, ा) and nukta (फ़) extend further below the Latin baseline and above the x-height than Latin descenders/ascenders, so they were being cut off by `overflow:hidden` on the mask. Fix: increase pb to 0.4em and add pt 0.08em (with matching negative margins to preserve layout spacing), plus bump H1 leading from 1.15 to 1.4. Verified: all three H1 lines show ~19px vertical headroom inside mask on mobile; no visible clipping at desktop or mobile.
